svg.title: Markov model: living kidney donation health states
svg.desc: Five health states (healthy post-donation, ESRD, standard waitlist, priority waitlist, post-transplant, death) with transitions between them.

g.onclick: sendPrompt('What parameters define the healthy post-donation state in this model?')
sendPrompt('What ESRD incidence rate should I use for living donors in the model?')
sendPrompt('What is the standard waitlist mortality rate per 100 patient-years in the SRTR data?')
sendPrompt('How does the priority allocation point system reduce wait time for prior living donors?')
sendPrompt('What are the 1-, 3-, 5-, and 10-year graft survival rates from SRTR data?')
